author: /root/lifecycle_controls
delta: Existing Lane.command gains a default-false internal capture_output_identity keyword. Only the layout diagnostic opts in; fstat records original device/inode/UID/file type immediately after exclusive xb open and before Popen. Ordinary command receipt keys and outcomes are unchanged.

Diagnostic raw output identity must match its original command descriptor before decoding/publishing. Cleanup additionally requires exact command/log/completed record, no command_cleanup_error, an exact integer exit, and canonical current-user regular-file identity equality. Failed stop, unresolved/no-child exit or replacement is retained with raw_removed=false for the existing outer finalizer.

Four added post-launch/replacement test methods, including timeout then stop failure/interruption, timeout then unresolved exit, reaped timeout cleanup, and otherwise-valid same-UID regular replacement. A completed leader plus output-budget/stop-error case also retains raw. Prelaunch failure expectations now conservatively retain output.

Existing bounded native layout decoder unchanged; ordinary kernel acceptance, runtime modes, launch intervals, app source and entitlements unchanged. Original kernel failure is rethrown identically; no provenance PASS or readiness claim.
static_compatibility: Inspected scripts/verification/ios-readiness/test_native_command_failures.py strict ordinary command keys and isolated-command globals. Optional false branch avoids new os/stat dependency or receipt fields there. Only stdlib AST/JSON/hash/source inspection performed, not test execution.
execution: Root alone adopts/runs tests/native. No tests, project imports/validators, builds/compiler, network/CI, or Git writes executed by this author.
